notes.title: Help the Cats 1.1 out now!
notes.content:
The full version of Help the Cats has finally been released. Customers who purchase early access can enjoy new content for free.

[h3][b]4 additional stages[/b][/h3]Four more cute and fun cat villages have been discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920324/0e6a4476a106928e5e4cdf2cbd6c81829dc49200.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920324/73daae25a3835d1726d7f1a4028c2df7d745fd0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920324/d550d59f8c3b0032e5ce3e80e06ba983d42ffea1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920324/c122034052584e115c1752093f676a48977c7f47.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=Nv8ydkbJtzo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]STORY[/b][/h3]Cat villages are discovered one by one along your journey, and each village has a connected story. If you hover your mouse over the stage entry icon, you can see a brief story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920324/3080cecc8186d8f01655f6bbbcb7aac6b5209882.png[/img]

[h3][b]Convenience improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]  Tutorial Guide
[*]  Added stage achievement goal information
[*]  Add stage exit information
[*]  Add credit page
[*]  Added 4 achievements
[/list]

Retains previous save files.

notes.title: Help the Cats 1.0 released will be soon.
notes.content:
The long Early Access journey is over and Help the Cats 1.0 will finally be released on September 12th. This is not the end of development, and we will continue to welcome you with various DLC, but today we want to share this good news with you. I will introduce in detail what has changed since its official release.

[h3][b]4 additional stages[/b][/h3]Four more cute and fun cat villages have been discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920324/0e6a4476a106928e5e4cdf2cbd6c81829dc49200.png[/img]

[h3][b]STORY[/b][/h3]Cat villages are discovered one by one along your journey, and each village has a connected story. If you hover your mouse over the stage entry icon, you can see a brief story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920324/3080cecc8186d8f01655f6bbbcb7aac6b5209882.png[/img]

[h3][b]Convenience improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]  Tutorial Guide
[*]  Added stage achievement goal information
[*]  Add stage exit information
[*]  Add credit page
[*]  Added 4 achievements
[/list]

Please understand that you must start from the new stage according to the official release version.

notes.title: Hotfix | Help the Cats Patch | 03.05.24
notes.content:
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to everyone who pre-ordered and played [Help the Cats].
I am checking valuable bug reports from players and fixing errors. We also released an updated version with some UI improvements.

If you're still experiencing previous or different issues. Please leave a comment on the community hub < Discussion < and we will upload a revised version as soon as possible.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Steam Duck in Stage 2 was selected twice.
[*] The bug where the three octopuses were not properly checked in stage 3 has been fixed.
[*] The bug where the three duck dolls were not properly checked in stage 7 has been fixed.
[*] When you find a hidden item, it turns blue so you can see it at a glance.
[/list]

notes.title: Help the Cats | Download now
notes.content:
You are the first explorer to discover ‘Cat land’, which has never been discovered before. In this land where only cats live, I have become a valuable guest who can help them. You can help cats by listening to their hints and finding hidden objects around them. Have fun exploring cute 'Cat land' with your lover, friends, family, and children. 

If you open the tomb incorrectly, you may be in for a surprise!
